entities.summary: Dioxippus was an ancient Greek athlete, renowned for his Olympic victories in the sport of pankration. His fame and skill were such that he was crowned Olympic champion by default in 336 BC when no other pankratiast dared meet him on the field. This kind of victory was called "akoniti". The most famous story of Dioxippus is his victory over Coragus of the Macedonian army.
